statement.zh: 教科文与学术综合将阿克苏姆表述为公元1–8世纪埃塞俄比亚高原重要王国，以石碑、王陵与红海贸易为标志（UNESCO 15；Phillipson 2012）。
statement.en: UNESCO and scholarly syntheses frame Aksum as a major highland kingdom of the 1st–8th centuries CE in northern Ethiopia, marked by stelae, royal tombs, and Red Sea trade (UNESCO 15; Phillipson 2012).
